title: The MisAnthropic Statement
excerpt: While Anthropic and its rivals are racing to build superintelligence through recursive self-improvement, Anthropic uniquely portrays itself as an AI safety company and leverages that reputation to advance its commercial and political ambitions. In light of its public offering, a broad coalition of signatories has endorsed the following statement:
content_html:
While Anthropic and its rivals are racing to build superintelligence through recursive self-improvement, Anthropic uniquely portrays itself as an AI safety company and leverages that reputation to advance its commercial and political ambitions. In light of its public offering, a broad coalition of signatories has endorsed the following statement:
